id.description: One word: the name of the kind; the Build menu and levels use it

label.description: The name shown in the Build menu

footprint.description: Width and height of the building on the grid, in metres

layout.description: The pieces of the building on a grid of 1 m cells, x to the right and y down, before any turn

piece.description: Which piece stands in this cell

x.description: Column of the cell, counted from the left of the footprint

y.description: Row of the cell, counted from the top of the footprint

interior.description: The name of the level file that is the building's inside; empty fades the roof instead

uses.description: What the building is used for: sleep, store, fire, craft...

owner.description: Who owns it: none, clan or person

light.description: A kind of light of lights.json that shines from a finished building at night; empty: none

wear.description: Hit points each piece loses when a season ends, by season name in lower case

additionalProperties.description: One entry, named by its key

known.description: The hero knows the blueprint at the start of a run

colour.description: The colour of its icon in the Build menu: # and six hex digits

note.description: The owner's own words about this kind (not read by the game)
note.example: A one-room hut: warm and sheltered once the walls, the door and the roof stand.

capacity.description: Storage kinds: meals of the clan's store it keeps at half the spoilage

cost.description: What is brought to the site (item: count); the sum of the pieces unless written here

additionalProperties.description: One entry, named by its key
